d: Enjoy this classic song 'Mohabbat Jisko Kehte Hain' sung by veteran singers Lata Mangeshkar and Hemant Kumar from 1962 Movie Maa Beta starring Manoj Kumar, Ameeta and Nirupa Roy in the lead. Maa Beta is Directed by Lekhraj Bhakri while the Music is composed by Hemant Kumar and Lyrics are penned by Prem Dhawan.
